title: Even moment bound for homogeneous functions
statement:
Let $n>0$ and let $r,k$ be nonnegative integers. Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ whose nonzero Fourier coefficients are supported only on sets of size $k$. Let $M_{r,k}$ be the finite set of codes of length $rk$ whose decoded list of pairs on the labels $0,\ldots,2rk-1$ has every pair joining labels in different consecutive blocks of $k$ labels. Then
\[\mathbb E_x f(x)^{2r}\leq \frac{|M_{r,k}|}{(k!)^r}\,W_k(f)^r,\]
where $W_k(f)$ is the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients indexed by sets of size $k$.
